cards.subject: A zone with no dungeon
lines: Feralas opened in patch 0.7, nine months before Dire Maul existed. For all that time the ruins were scenery you rode past.
Patch 1.3.0 was titled "Ruins of the Dire Maul", and turned a levelling zone into an endgame destination overnight.

cards.subject: Eldre'Thalas
lines: A Highborne city twelve thousand years old. Prince Tortheldrin's followers conjured a spell that shielded it from the Sundering, so it survived — intact, and cut off.
Its arcanists imprisoned the demon Immol'thar behind five pylons and drank his energy for ten thousand years to live without the Well of Eternity.

cards.subject: The prince did the arithmetic
lines: When the demon's power started to thin, he did not ration it.
He murdered most of his own people so that the survivors — and he — would each get a larger share.
"The once beautiful city became an ogre-infested ruin."

cards.subject: Feathermoon Stronghold
cards.tag: It is not on the mainland
lines: The night elf capital of Feralas is out on Sardor Isle, off the western coast, over the water.
The Cataclysm drowns it and it becomes the Ruins of Feathermoon, held by naga.
The Feathermoon on a modern map is a different town in a different place.

cards.subject: Ruins of Ravenwind
lines: Everyone remembers Dire Maul. Ravenwind in the north is the zone's other Highborne settlement — same people, same age, no dungeon attached.
Northspring harpies have it now.

cards.subject: Shay Leafrunner
lines: An absent-minded night elf girl to escort back to the mountain giant who looks after her.
She wanders off.
That is the quest, and it is the only thing anyone remembers about it.

cards.subject: Ruins of Isildien
cards.tag: Go up the stairs at the end
lines: A night elf city destroyed ten thousand years ago, held by Gordunni ogres now.
The large round building at the back is shaped like Darnassus's Temple of the Moon.
It was probably a temple of Elune, and nothing there says so.

cards.subject: The Sprite Darters
lines: The Grimtotem captured a lot of these rare faerie dragons, and a night elf sends you to free them.
The chain ends with an egg, and the pet was Alliance-exclusive until long after this.
Deleted from the game entirely in 4.0.3a.

cards.subject: There is a chicken in the tunnel
lines: At the back of the first tunnel there is a trapped mechanical chicken. Find its distress beacon and it wakes up and asks to be walked home.
One of three of them scattered across the world.

cards.subject: Dream Bough
lines: A Great Tree holding one of the portals into the Emerald Dream, guarded by green dragonspawn.
Patch 1.8.0 put a Dragon of Nightmare on it.
For the rest of this game's life a forty-man raid boss can be standing on a lake island in a levelling zone.

cards.subject: The Writhing Deep
lines: A silithid hive whose Zukk'ash are driving the nearby gnolls into a frenzy.
Camp Mojache cleared the surface.
The eggs are still down in the hive.

cards.subject: The Isle of Dread
cards.tag: The best food in the game
lines: The chimaeroks on this island are the only source of Chimaerok Tenderloin, and so the only source of Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops.
Twenty-five stamina, added for Ahn'Qiraj, and once the most powerful consumable there was.
Every serious raider's food came off one island in Feralas.

cards.subject: The Twin Colossals
lines: Two vertical mountains on the west side, with the road to Desolace running between them.
There is a small lake at the top of the eastern one, and you can fish in it.
